title.zh: 【消息人士：韩国倾向再推迟两年征收加密收益资本利得税】
title.en: 【消息人士：韩国倾向再推迟两年征收加密收益资本利得税】

current_state.zh: South Korea is reportedly leaning toward delaying its crypto capital gains tax by two years, pushing the planned January 2027 levy to 2029, with a final decision expected during November parliamentary tax subcommittee discussions amid concerns over access to foreign exchange data until the U.S. joins OECD CARF in 2029.
current_state.en: South Korea is reportedly leaning toward delaying its crypto capital gains tax by two years, pushing the planned January 2027 levy to 2029, with a final decision expected during November parliamentary tax subcommittee discussions amid concerns over access to foreign exchange data until the U.S. joins OECD CARF in 2029.
